newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen consolidating on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen consolidating on retail buying.

text.p: Retail buying was expected to intensify on Wednesday, helping Dhaka shares to consolidate Tuesday's recovery from a prolonged bear-run, brokers said.
"Prices have become so attractive that more investors are expected to be active. Tuesday's recovery will help raise the shaken confidence," said broker Shakil Rizvi.
Brokers said selling pressure would ease further as the deadline for bidding for IPOs of a new issue expired on Tuesday.
The DSE index rose 4.91 points, or 0.52 percent, to 944.57 on a turnover of 46.2 million taka on Tuesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
